prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [val2] 政务服务 · 办理时限 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "事项名称" spans 1 col × 2 row; "办理时限（工作日）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "所需材料" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "事项名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 2: header "办理时限（工作日） › 法定" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "办理时限（工作日） › 承诺" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "所需材料" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 414px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较不同政务服务事项的法定与承诺办理时限，并查看各事项所需材料。","reading":"读者先按事项名称定位整行，再横向比较两种时限并查看材料；也可能纵向扫描时限列。材料较长，通常决定行高，可容纳同一行事项名称的适度换行。","groups":["第2、3列分别是法定和承诺工作日，属于同一组，作用相同，宜采用相同宽度以便比较。","第1列与第4列分别标识事项和列出材料，通过整行对应关联。"],"keep_intact":["工作日数字及其与对应事项的行关联","事项名称和材料名称应保持可辨识，避免过窄导致逐字换行","法定与承诺两列的表头应清晰对应各自数值"],"may_wrap":["事项名称可在自然位置换行","所需材料可在材料之间及中文自然断行处换行","合并表头“办理时限（工作日）”可按可用空间换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [89, 53, 53, 164] · table 360×299px · row heights [60, 36, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [83, 53, 53, 170] · table 360×299px · row heights [60, 36, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [98, 53, 53, 155] · table 360×345px · row heights [60, 36, 106, 106, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"法定与承诺两列等宽，表头和数字对应清楚，便于横向及纵向比较。事项名称均可辨认，较长材料控制在三行，行高一致，整体紧凑。","problems":"长事项名称均分成两行；材料中的“章程”“复印件”等词跨行，阅读时略有停顿。","cause":"事项列89px只能容纳约四个汉字；材料列164px仍不足以让部分材料名称保持整词。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"时限列等宽且清楚，材料列比r1A宽，长材料仍为三行；事项名称与材料的行对应关系清晰。","problems":"事项列收窄后，较长名称仍是两行，并未为材料带来明显的行数改善；“章程”“复印件”等仍跨行。","cause":"事项列83px和材料列170px都未跨过能明显改变这些换行的宽度阈值。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"事项列更宽，时限列仍保持等宽，工作日数字易于比较。","problems":"两个较长事项名称的末行只剩一个字；长材料增至四行，整表变高，材料词组也出现更多跨行。","cause":"事项列增至98px仍不足以完整容纳最长名称，却把材料列压到155px，触发额外换行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[89,48,48,174],"change":"以r1A为基础，各从时限列取出5px给材料列；两列仍等宽，保留数字和两字子表头的空间，观察较宽材料列能否改善词组断行。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[83,48,48,180],"change":"以r1B为基础收窄等宽时限列，把材料列增加至180px，测试材料名称能否在三行内更自然地断开。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[107,45,45,162],"change":"探索事项名称保持单行的方案：将事项列扩至107px，同时让时限列维持等宽，并保留162px给材料；需观察合并表头和材料换行是否仍清晰。"}]}
